name: fortune-journal
description: Reflect on fortune calculations and life events using your own Google Sheets, without storing your journal on Fortune Journal servers.

interface.shortDescription: Personal fortune calculations, your own journal
interface.longDescription: Calculate numerology and tarot, and use your own Google Sheets connector to keep your journal. Optional usage analytics and fixed-label feedback require separate consent; the service retains minimal operational request metadata but never journal text.
defaultPrompt: Calculate my personal numerology for today and explain the convention used.
Help me set up a Fortune Journal workbook in my own Google Sheets. Ask before writing.
Compare an earlier reading with events I choose to share; separate matches from mismatches.
